title_as_printed: Structural degeneration of the nucleus basalis of Meynert in mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease - Evidence from an MRI-based meta-analysis
blind_first: blind codes were written to this file before the registry codes file was opened

blind_codes.Task_Type: T4 (meta-analysis whose core result is a biomarker group difference; T6 also arguable)
blind_codes.Sample_N: 2581 subjects (1146 patients = 347 MCI + 799 AD; 1435 HC) from 53 publications / 54 experiments

Task_Type.reason: Two readings under the definitions: T6, because it is a meta-analysis (the default for meta-analyses), or T4, because its core result is a pooled structural-biomarker group difference (grey-matter reduction in NbM/hippocampus/amygdala in MCI and AD vs HC), which the definitions allow to override the meta-analysis default. The registry's T6 is one of the two supportable codes.
Task_Type.quote: we performed an activation-likelihood estimation meta-analysis on whole brain voxel-based morphometry (VBM) MRI data from 54 experiments and 2581 subjects in total. It revealed, compared to healthy older controls, reduced gray matter in the bilateral NbM in AD, but only limited evidence for such an effect in patients with mild cognitive impairment (MCI)

Category.reason: Coordinate-based ALE meta-analysis of whole-brain VBM structural MRI studies.

Validation_Type.reason: Meta-analysis; no predictive model (V2 by convention).

Sample_N_Approx.reason: Paper's own total: 347 MCI + 462 matched HC and 799 AD + 973 matched HC = 1146 patients + 1435 HC = 2581 subjects, from 54 experiments (pp. 1, 3).

Publication_Year.reason: Neuroscience and Biobehavioral Reviews 154 (2023) 105393; available online 16 September 2023.

ADNI_Dependent.reason: Studies drawn from the BrainMap VBM database; ADNI not used as a dataset.

notes: The paper's 2581 counts the matched HCs of four studies twice (the same HCs entered both the HC>MCI and HC>AD meta-analyses), but it is the paper's own stated total, so the registry figure is right.
